components.name: hindsight-runtime
components.sources: PyInstaller onedir build of hindsight-api 1.0.0 (slim venv, arm64, adhoc-signed)

components.name: embeddings-model
components.sources: Xenova/multilingual-e5-small onnx/model_int8.onnx + tokenizer files (HF cache snapshot 761b726d, symlinks dereferenced)

components.name: pg0-installation
components.sources: pg0 embedded PostgreSQL installation 18.1.0 (pre-seeded; prevents first-run download)

components.name: memory-adapter
components.sources: copy of nisse/spike/m1-c-hindsight (src byte-identical) + @vectorize-io/hindsight-client 1.0.0 runtime files (MIT); sidecar relative-import target

clientPackage.name: @vectorize-io/hindsight-client
clientPackage.note: only runtime files staged; bundle is self-contained (no runtime npm dependencies)

runtimeVersions.nodeSidecar: Node >= 20 ESM (Electron runs it with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1)

offlineRecipe.isolation: HOME=<dataRoot>/home; user DSH home never passed to children; no network egress for embeddings/DB

notes: PyInstaller onedir is adhoc-signed (arm64); A-stream must re-sign nested binaries with Developer ID + hardened runtime before notarization.
pg0 downloads PostgreSQL on first start unless <HOME>/.pg0/installation/18.1.0 is pre-seeded; run-server.sh seeds it from the bundle.

sidecar.mjs is a byte-identical copy of m4/memory/sidecar.mjs and imports ../../spike/m1-c-hindsight/src/index.mjs relative to its own path; packaged layout must place adapter at Contents/spike/m1-c-hindsight.
